verdict.rationale: Notion's REST API covers broad workspace surface area: reading, creating and updating pages, databases, users and comments. It adds webhooks, Agent session and management APIs, an MCP server and a published OpenAPI spec. However, the vendor's own wording is "nearly everything" rather than full UI parity, and a community report says users "quickly reach limits of what is possible automatically." Missing for 10: an explicit claim or documentation of complete API–UI parity, an enumeration of which UI features lack API coverage, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
